title: h225: avoid format truncation warnings
description:
Instead of a fixed buffer (which inevitably results in warnings because
it is prepended and appended to later), use wmem_strdup_printf with
pinfo->pool memory.

Ping #20175

notes.body: Now all we have to make sure that the lifetime of a h225_packet_info structure does not extend beyond the packet pool lifetime. I haven't checked that, yet.

The frame label is copied in the tap for use there: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/ui/voip_calls.c#L2113

The structure in general doesn't from what I checked isn't accessed past the lifetime. The larger structure is already packet pool scoped, this affects the label.
